markup.message: <lt-suggestion> has options with data-value, but no .lt-suggestion__value. The code the user picks is then not sent with the form, only the text in the field. Write <input type="hidden" class="lt-suggestion__value" name="…"> in the field, so the component fills it.
<lt-suggestion> has an .lt-suggestion__value, but no options with data-value. The field stays empty. Give every option a data-value with the code it stands for.
